breedAminals(address,address).details: Launches gene auctions for offspring Requirements: - Minimum breeding fee must be paid - Both addresses must be valid Aminals - Caller must have sufficient love for at both Aminals - Both Aminals must have sufficient energy to breed

returns.auctionId: Gene auction ID "When two Aminals unite in love, their digital essence mingles  through algorithms of affection, creating new life from pure emotion"

constructor.details: Sets up the basic contract with owner permissions

getAminalByIndex(uint256).details: Retrieves address from the sequential registry of spawned Aminals

returns.aminalAddress: Address of the Aminal at specified index

getAminalVisualsByAddress(address).details: Retrieves genetic profile for rendering and display purposes

params.aminalAddress: Address of the Aminal to query

returns.visuals: Complete Visuals struct with all trait gene IDs

initialize(address,address,address).details: Sets up connections to auction, proposal, and gene systems Requirements: - Can only be called once due to initializer modifier - Must be called by contract owner

params._aminalProposals: Address of the governance proposals contract
params._geneAuction: Address of the gene auction contract
params._genes: Address of the gene NFT contract

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setup().details: Creates the Variable Rate Gradual Dutch Auction mechanism for love pricing Requirements: - Must be called by owner after initialization - Uses predefined constants for optimal love curve parameters

spawnAminal(address,address,uint256,uint.details: Creates offspring from two parent Aminals with auction-determined genetics Requirements: - Can only be called by the authorized gene auction contract - Parent addresses must be valid Aminal contracts - Gene IDs must correspond to existing traits

params.auctionId: Gene auction ID that created this child
params.parentOne: Address of the first parent Aminal
params.parentTwo: Address of the second parent Aminal
params.winningGeneIds: Array of 8 gene IDs selected by auction for each trait

returns.childAddress: Address of the newly spawned Aminal

spawnInitialAminals((uint256,uint256,uin.details: Creates the initial population of Aminals with predefined genetics Requirements: - Can only be called once by the owner - Each visual configuration must have valid gene IDs

params._visuals: Array of visual DNA configurations for genesis Aminals "In the beginning, there was code. From code came the first Aminals,  the digital Adam and Eve of the blockchain paradise."

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.
